content.name: Player Builder Autodispatch
content.description:
Player-owned builders running [b]Find Build Tasks[/b] do not automatically respond when one of your own stations needs a construction vessel. This is not a range or a pilot-skill problem: the vanilla script explicitly broadcasts automatic requests only for non-player build modules.
This mod enables those requests for player-owned stations, and makes them private to your own builders.
[h2]What it does[/h2] When a station build or reconstruction reaches the point where it has the required resources and is waiting for a construction vessel, an available player-owned builder running Find Build Tasks can accept it automatically.
Before accepting, the builder must also have a valid gate route to the station under its current sector-travel blacklist. A builder trapped in an unreachable area, or cut off by its own blacklist, ignores the signal so another eligible builder can answer it instead.
NPC construction behaviour is completely unchanged. A player station's request is rejected on every non-player builder, so a nearby NPC builder can never quietly take the job outside the normal hire and payment flow.
[h2]Settings[/h2] None, and no options menu. There is nothing to tune - the mod either applies or it does not, which is why it needs no configuration API.
It does not assign an arbitrary idle builder either. The ship must already have [b]Find Build Tasks[/b] as its running default behaviour, and must pass every vanilla check: unassigned, able to dock by relation, within the station's five-jump request search, and with the station inside the builder behaviour's own configured search range.
The station still needs its ordinary vanilla prerequisites. Destroyed modules are returned to the construction plan by the station engineer automatically, but reconstruction cannot start until build storage holds the required wares. Damaged modules that were not destroyed use the station repair system instead and need no builder at all.
[h2]Dependencies[/h2] [list] [*][b]X4: Foundations 9.00[/b] - required. [*]No DLC required, and no other mod required. [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] Works on an existing savegame and stores no state of its own. Two small XPath patches on the vanilla AI scripts build.buildstorage.xml and order.build.find.task.xml, each verified to match exactly one node in 9.00.
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/drjele/x4-player-builder-autodispatch

text.name: Player Builder Autodispatch
text.description: Lets player-owned stations automatically request a construction vessel when a build or reconstruction task is ready, while ensuring that those requests can only be accepted by player-owned builders running Find Build Tasks. NPC construction behaviour is unchanged.
